kev.detail: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
kev.title: OSGeo GeoServer - OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability

kev.detail: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
kev.title: OSGeo GeoServer - OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability

kev.detail: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.
kev.title: Drupal Core - Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability

nvd.title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Nitramix Revertix – Backup, Migration, Staging & Clone revertix allows Object Injection.This issue affects Revertix – Backup, Migration, Staging & Clone: from n/a through 1.0.3.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in expresstechsoftware MemberPress Discord Addon expresstechsoftwares-memberpress-discord-add-on allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MemberPress Discord Addon: from n/a through 1.1.5.

A vulnerability has been identified in Mendix OIDC Provider (Mendix 10 compatible) (All versions < V6.0.0), Mendix OIDC Provider (Mendix 11 compatible) (All versions < V6.0.0), Mendix OIDC Provider (Mendix 9 compatible) (All versions < V4.3.0). Affected versions of the module do not properly validate the integrity of JWTs submitted to the OIDC Provider Token Introspection endpoint, allowing tokens to be associated with legitimate token records based solely on their jti value.

This could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack an account (session) when gaining access to an jti of an active token.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in David Lingren Media LIbrary Assistant media-library-assistant allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Media LIbrary Assistant: from n/a through 3.43.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Hello Clever Pty Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce cleverpay-gateway allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.8.4.

ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01. Affected is the function soapcgi_main of the file /soap.cgi of the component UPnP Igd Control Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument service leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. Affected by this vulnerability is the function gena.php::GENA_notify_init of the file htdocs/upnpinc/gena.php of the component UPnP Event Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument uri results in os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

A Missing Authorization vulnerability in the private console API in Google Cloud Vertex AI (Vertex AI Assistant) versions prior to 2026-04-13 on Google Cloud Platform allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to list, read, create, and send messages in other users' chat sessions using crafted API requests.


This vulnerability was patched on 13 April 2026, and no customer action is needed.

An Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs in the namespace onboarding API in Google Cloud GKE Fleet versions prior to 2026-09-25 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to project owner using a privileged system namespace onboarding request.


This vulnerability was patched on 25 September 2026, and no customer action is needed.

A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. This impacts the function FUN_0040ed90 of the file wfadev.cgi of the component UPnP/WFA. This manipulation of the argument SOAPAction causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.
